correctness.rationale: The fast-x algebraic branch, nullcline inverse, h-prime numerator and sharp cubic elimination are exact identities checked by a reproducible symbolic script; a case split covers all positive q including q=1. Explicit inward rectangle inequalities ensure bounded complete positive trajectories. The unique equilibrium has positive Jacobian determinant. Nonnegative h-prime above the cutoff gives strict negative divergence, a sink and global convergence. Below it an explicit hyperbolic source and positively invariant annulus force a periodic orbit by Poincare--Bendixson; no numerical orbit sampling substitutes for the proof.

value.rationale: For a canonical chemically motivated dimensionless feedback-strength q in an explicitly published planar reduction, the theorem gives a sharp full-parameter family dichotomy: universally no self-sustained oscillations above q* versus constructively possible oscillations at every q below. Its global scope and sharp constructive converse provide model-level dynamical classification, beyond a textbook fixed-point or negative-divergence check.
